ambient_events: The hand-strung bulbs sway very slightly. Air is moving somewhere ahead.
A trolley of type-cases stands against the wall, waiting for somebody to have a spare hour.
Every door off the spine is labelled by shape rather than by word — a wheel, a leaf, a flame.
description: A long service corridor behind a second, heavier door — the part of the base that most of the Watch have never been shown. Bare bulbs on a hand-strung line, doors off both sides, and a smell of ink and hot metal drifting up it. This is not where the Watch live. This is where the Watch work.
name: The Spine
